name: Medicine shortages
value: 7 UK SSPs active; US chemo shortages persist
summary: Seven UK Serious Shortage Protocols active into January; US cancer centres still report chemotherapy shortages
state: NHSBSA's list checked on 18 Nov shows seven active Serious Shortage Protocols: lansoprazole orodispersible tablets to 15 Jan 2027, and Estradot patches and Creon 25000 capsules to 8 Jan 2027, with none newer than September (NHSBSA). In the US, shortages of cytarabine, irinotecan, carboplatin and other chemotherapy drugs persist; a September survey found 7% of cancer centres could not continue some treatments (Becker's, 26 Oct). Searches on 18 Nov found no widespread rationing across major health systems, so Watch holds.
for_you: Under a Serious Shortage Protocol, pharmacists can supply an alternative without a new prescription. People affected can speak to their pharmacist or GP; NHS guidance covers how SSPs work.
rubric_hit: Watch: UK Serious Shortage Protocols for widely used medicines (7 active, NHSBSA); no widespread rationing across major systems

why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
